QUOTE: "The library itself spawns nothing, so the library's concurrency contract is "caller's problem": a multithreaded application must enable `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` plus a backend" and "`library/threading.c` (guarded by `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`) has two layers: Function-pointer hooks. `mbedtls_mutex_init/free/lock/unlock` are global function pointers."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that none of the threads are in library/ ("None are in `library/`. The library itself spawns nothing"). It also says library/threading.c supplies the mutex abstraction (`mbedtls_mutex_*` hooks) for threaded callers.
